create_AverageMeter: create an AverageMeter to compute and store the average and current value of training metrics
update_AverageMeter: update an AverageMeter with a new value and optional count and epoch for tracking statistics
create_Stats: create a Stats object to log training statistics like objective and top1e for a deep net
plot_stats: plot training statistics to a visdom server and export charts to a PDF file
synchronize_logged_vars: synchronize logged variables in Stats by removing extras and filling missing stats with default values
